CustomField.description: Org-wide address of the site page that shows a form by Form Template Id. Form_Template__c.Web_Form_URL__c reads it when the template has no Web Form Site URL, so every template's Open Web Form button works once this is filled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The page on your main site that shows a form by template Id, for example https://yoursite.my.site.com/forms. The Open Web Form button adds the template Id to the end. A template's Web Form Site URL overrides it.
CustomField.label: Default Web Form URL
